actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.desc: The warlord yells a rallying cry to its allies. Each friendly creature within 30 feet of the warlord that can hear the warlord has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the warlord's next turn.
